derivation.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Canvas adjustment only for a photographed bottle cutout. Using the supplied complete Don Adriano Añejo bottle, trim the empty alpha margins so output is a very narrow tall PORTRAIT asset, approximately 360 pixels wide by1440pixels tall. Bottle must occupy 90–96% of canvas width and 96% of canvas height. Maintain true transparent alpha. The entire bottle including cap and base must remain visible with a little transparent gap on all four sides. Preserve exact photographed bottle proportions, materials, cap, label, fine words and artwork; do not redesign, repaint, invent, warp, rotate or cut into the bottle. ONLY remove surplus transparent canvas and any stray distant edge pixels; no added shadow, backdrop, ground, box, reflection or checkerboard.
